svg.title: Step 5: Tailored resume (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 5 Tailored resume. Now: One fixed PDF for the whole batch; Claims registry with provenance and sensitivity; draft_cv accepts only exact claims or approved paraphrases; Review with severity floors; render and text gates; Never ready, never reached. Target: Owner decision: what "ready" means; Three or four variants, built once; Pick by role family; tailor only the best; Attachment per envelope; Why-this-resume note, shown at approval. Metric: Every send records its variant; reply rate by variant and interview rate of tailored versus variant sends are compared.
